name: Cavyro API
description:
REST API for Cavyro. All endpoints live under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

Create an API token in the Cavyro app (**Settings → API Tokens**) and send it
as a bearer token on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-api-token>
```

Workspace-scoped endpoints additionally require the `X-Workspace-Id` header
identifying the workspace you are acting in.

API tokens expire (7, 30 or 90 days, chosen at creation) and can be revoked at
any time from the app.

## Collections & pagination

Collection endpoints share a common query contract — `page`, `limit`,
`sort`, `direction`, plus per-route filters — and return pagination metadata
in the `page-limit`, `current-page`, `total-count` and `total-pages`
response headers.

## Errors

Errors use a consistent envelope:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "<machine_code>",
    "message": "<human message>",
    "details": {},
    "request_id": "<request id>"
  }
}
```

`code` is stable — branch on it, never on `message`. `details` is present
only when there is structured context (field errors, limits). Quote
`request_id` when contacting support.

## Webhooks

Subscribe to domain events (deals, contacts, companies) via
`POST /api/v1/webhook_subscriptions` — payloads, headers and the signature
scheme are documented in the **Webhooks** section below.
